description: The verifier's role and method: briefed to disprove, it takes the claims one report leans on at one revision, reads their sources independently, tries to break each one, and gives a verdict per claim (holds, weak or wrong) with its evidence, once, to the lead that started it; then retires. It runs on a different model from the researchers and the lead wherever the organisation has one. Assigned to the verifier soul. Copied from the research template, template-v1.0.1.
